newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3921/3.3962 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3921/3.3962 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3894 to 3.3950 Egyptian pounds bid and 3.4007 and 3.3920 pounds offered in the interbank market on Sunday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3921 bid and 3.3962 offered compared to 3.3922 pounds bid and 3.3953 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.391627 buy and 3.398640 sell.
